data.name: Huzayfa
data.gender_notes: Huzayfa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Huzayfa bin Al-Yaman was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). He participated in several battles and was one of the Ten Promised Paradise. His name is mentioned in the Quran and Hadiths. The name Huzayfa carries the meaning “Friend of the Prophet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huzayfa usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the prophet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A friend in faith and righteousness.
data.etymology: Huzayfa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend of the Prophet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huzayfa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

His descendants continue to hold a place of honor and respect in Islamic culture.
